title: Veilbound
description: Explore forgotten lands filled with secrets, dungeons, and powerful artifacts.
body:
Veilbound introduces an entirely new mysterious dimension, known as the Forgotten Realm. There’s no portal — only ancient rituals and strange artifacts can bring you across. Inside, you’ll find haunting biomes, cursed structures, and lost beings that wander between life and death.

🌍 Main Features

New Dimension – The Forgotten Realm
A hidden world full of mist, ruins, and glowing soul energy. No portal — discover secret ways to enter.

Custom Biomes
Explore areas like the Wailing Woods where fog thickens and strange light dances through the trees.

Structures & Loot
Find Forgotten Camps, Vendor Houses, and hidden ruins containing rare loot like soul Fragments.

New Entities
Encounter the Forgotten Wanderer, a lost being that roams the veil in search of purpose.

Magical Items & Artifacts

Exile Sigil — a mysterious artifact that shifts reality.

Totem of Whispers — grants unique powers when held.

Soul Fragment — a rare drop used for crafting advanced relics.

Custom Mechanics & Trades
Villagers can trade new items through Wailing Trades, and new procedures add depth to gameplay with custom events and interactions.

⚔️ Gameplay

Veilbound is focused on exploration, mystery, and atmosphere. There’s no handholding — only your curiosity.
The mod mixes adventure, survival, and lore-driven exploration. Every artifact has a purpose, and every biome hides a secret.

🌀 Planned Features

More Forgotten biomes

New boss entity tied to soul energy

Expanding lore and story quests
